modules.title: 学习者从发现课程到开始第一课经历了哪些触点
用户旅程怎样呈现完整经历

items.title: 从一个用户和目标开始
items.text: 明确研究的是哪类用户、什么场景和哪段时间，避免把不同人的经历拼成一条虚假的平均路径。

items.title: 连接产品内外的触点
items.text: 社交分享、介绍页、支付、邮件、应用和客服都可能影响同一个目标，不能只记录页面点击。

items.title: 区分证据与假设
items.text: 访谈、反馈和行为数据可以支持旅程判断；团队推测需要明确标注并安排验证。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: {c:user-journey} 跨时间和触点记录行动、想法、感受与证据；{c:user-flow} 聚焦一个产品目标中的页面、动作和决策分支。两者可以描述同一任务，但回答的问题不同。

lessonPractice.title: 下面哪份材料最接近“第一次购买并开始课程”的用户旅程？

options.label: 按发现、了解、购买、收到邮件、进入课程分阶段，记录每个触点的行动、疑问、情绪和访谈或行为证据
options.feedback: 对。它跨越多个触点和时间阶段，并且把行动、想法、感受与证据放在一起。

options.label: 只画登录页、课程列表和播放页之间的点击分支
options.feedback: 这更接近 User Flow，只覆盖产品内完成任务的动作和分支。

options.label: 团队直接写“用户一定很兴奋”，不记录访谈、反馈或行为依据
options.feedback: 旅程图可以记录感受，但必须区分证据、推断和待验证假设，不能替用户编造情绪。

en.title: Which artifact is closest to the user journey for buying and starting a course?

options.label: Map discovery, evaluation, purchase, email, and course entry, with actions, questions, feelings, and interview or behavior evidence at each touchpoint
options.feedback: Correct. It spans time and touchpoints while connecting actions, thoughts, feelings, and evidence.

options.label: Show only the click branches between sign-in, the course list, and the player
options.feedback: That is closer to a user flow, which focuses on actions and decisions inside the product.

options.label: Write “users will definitely feel excited” without interviews, feedback, or behavior evidence
options.feedback: A journey can include feelings, but it must separate evidence, inference, and assumptions.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把“第一次购买并开始课程”整理成用户旅程，覆盖发现、了解、购买、收到通知和开始学习。每个阶段写清触点、用户行动、问题、感受、阻碍和已有证据；访谈原话与数据分开标注，没有依据的内容写成待验证假设。最后指出最需要继续调查的摩擦点，不要把它缩成产品内 User Flow。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Map the user journey for buying and starting a course for the first time across discovery, evaluation, purchase, notification, and first learning. For each stage, state the touchpoint, action, question, feeling, obstacle, and available evidence. Label interview quotes separately from behavioral data and mark unsupported claims as hypotheses. Identify the friction that needs more research without reducing the journey to an in-product user flow.

references.title: 用户旅程图是什么？
references.title_en: What Is a User Journey Map?

references.title: 客户旅程图是什么？
references.title_en: What Is a Customer Journey Map?

learning.assumes: You can map an in-product task but have not connected discovery, purchase, use, and support touchpoints.
learning.outcome: You can organize stages, actions, touchpoints, thoughts, feelings, obstacles, and evidence, then distinguish a user journey from a user flow.

modules.title: Follow a learner from discovery to the first lesson
How a user journey represents the complete experience

items.title: Start with one user and goal
items.text: Define the user, situation, and time span instead of mixing different people's experiences.

items.title: Connect touchpoints inside and outside the product
items.text: Social sharing, pages, payment, email, the app, and support may all affect one goal.

items.title: Separate evidence from assumptions
items.text: Interviews, feedback, and behavior data support claims; team guesses remain hypotheses.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A {c:user-journey} spans time and touchpoints with actions, thoughts, feelings, and evidence. A {c:user-flow} focuses on pages, actions, and decisions for one in-product goal.
